title: Big and small: measuring
examples: Teacher, which toy is heavier, the car or the block?
How do I know if something is longer?
Can we compare these two things?

explain.say: Today we are learning to compare things. We can compare how big or small things are.
Next we can compare how long or short things are. Look at these two pencils.
We can also compare how heavy or light things are. Which one feels more weight?
Sometimes things are big and heavy. A big rock might feel very heavy to lift.
Now let us think about everyday things. When you carry your backpack, you compare things all the time.
A common mistake is thinking bigger things are always heavier. A big balloon is actually very light.

faq.q: How do I know if something is longer?
faq.a: You can place the two things end to end to see which one takes up more space.
No, big means taking up a lot of space, and heavy means having a lot of weight.
asks: What is the difference between size and weight?

faq.a: A feather is light because it is made of very soft and airy material.
asks: Why can I blow a feather easily?

faq.q: Can I compare things that are not next to each other?
faq.a: Yes, you can compare them by looking at pictures or knowing how they are usually sized.
asks: Can I compare a tree and a car?
Do I need to touch them to compare?

faq.q: What is the best way to compare weight?
faq.a: The best way is to use a balance scale to see which side goes down more.
asks: What tool shows which is heavier?
Should I use my hands or a scale?

facts: We use words like longer and shorter to compare length.
We use words like heavier and lighter to compare weight.
A balance scale helps us compare how much weight things have.

quiz.say: Which is bigger, a marble or a soccer ball?
quiz.why: The soccer ball takes up much more space than the small marble.

wrong.0: You might think it is bigger because it is shiny.
wrong.1: They are different objects with different sizes.
wrong.2: You might think you need a ruler to know.

quiz.say: If I compare a feather and a rock, which is heavier?
quiz.why: A rock is made of hard material and has much more weight than a feather.

wrong.0: You might think you need a scale to know.
wrong.2: You might think it is heavier because it is dark.
wrong.3: They are different things with different weights.

quiz.say: Which word describes something that is not big, like a ladybug?
quiz.why: Small means it takes up very little space.

wrong.0: Light describes how much it weighs, not its size.
wrong.2: Long describes how something stretches out.
wrong.3: Heavy describes how much weight it has.
